description: Two-portal square arena, like ib1 but with the gates on perpendicular sides (north and east) instead of opposite sides — so the straight-line route between gates is an L through the center rather than a straight N↔S line. Wide open floor for combat.

portals.north: spawn_north at (-0.16, -23.95) — gate on the north (low-Z) side
portals.east: spawn_east at (23.99, 0.36) — gate on the east (high-X) side

anchors.description: center of the square arena — dispatch anchor (matches oc5a)

traversalNotes: Direct N↔E route is an L through the center: spawn_north → arena_center → spawn_east (and reverse). Both legs are axis-aligned (one north-south, one east-west), keeping the autopilot's camera-relative input clean.
DISPATCH RULE: any in-cell objective routes through arena_center (oc5a). Walk current_gate → arena_center → objective → arena_center → next_gate.
Wide combat floor: kill_all may spawn enemies anywhere on the square. After combat, return to arena_center before heading to the exit gate.
Same shape primitive as ib1 (square arena) — the only difference is which two gates exist. Solver should treat this as the SAME pattern as ib1 with gate-direction labels swapped.
